value.rationale: Two canonical ten-vertex 3-regular graphs provide a controlled, full state-space counterexample to extending known CCA/GHM eventual-period equality beyond bicliques. The mismatch concerns 4800 states across 40 free graph-symmetry orbits rather than an arbitrary isolated witness, and yields a useful exact natural dynamical invariant and benchmark.
